scope.query_filter: season=2022 AND week IN (1,2,3,4,5); E1 pool weeks 1-4 only
scope.holdout_status: NOT HOLDOUT-VALIDATED: weeks 6-9 were already examined in prior E3 work; week 5 is development evidence only
scope.metric: same-quarter game-clock delta from first scrimmage snap in a drive through the PBP row immediately after its final E1-vocabulary play; this is game-clock time, not wall-clock possession duration
scope.authored_conditioning: Week-5 observed initial state; E1 field direction is authored dir=+1; no outcome from the target drive enters the generated sequence

limitations: The E1 baseline is an empirical drive generator, not an independently calibrated physical model.
Week-5 starts are conditioned from observed PBP, while generated terminal outcomes and subsequent states are sampled from weeks 1-4.
Game-clock delta omits wall-clock stoppage duration and cannot be interpreted as real elapsed possession time.
Same-quarter censoring drops drives crossing quarter boundaries; E1 samples only five deterministic draws per observed start.
Weeks 6-9 were already examined in prior E3 work, so none of this comparison is holdout-validated.
The authored dir=+1 field orientation is a simulation convention, not an observed direction assignment.
